evals.prompt: Synchronize selected Salesforce records into our application without letting Salesforce-specific statuses leak across the domain.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines a mapping/anti-corruption boundary, failure semantics, and reconciliation.

evals.prompt: Download lyrics from an external API in the background while music keeps playing, handling provider failures without blocking playback.
evals.expected_output: Integration failure/mapping is explicit and supporting async/reliability concerns are reported.

evals.prompt: Design the public API contract our own consumers will call.
evals.expected_output: integration-engineering is not primary; api-design owns the contract.

evals.prompt: A provider returns 429s under load and retries are making the outage worse.
evals.expected_output: The skill addresses deadlines, retry classification, backoff/provider signals, and observability rather than blindly retrying.

evals.prompt: Payment webhooks occasionally arrive twice or not at all; local state must eventually converge.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines deduplication, source of truth, acknowledgement, and reconciliation/backfill behavior.
